newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian NIB plans name change to Citibank.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian NIB plans name change to Citibank.

text.p: Nigerian International Bank plans to change its name to Citibank following the acquisition of 75 percent ownership by the American bank, a company spokesman said on Friday.
"We hope that within six months the name change will be finalised, although our business focus will remain the same," the spokesman said.
Earlier this year Citibank upped its stake in NIB to 75 percent from 40 percent previously.
"Under this government Nigeria has attained a level of macroeconomic stability, and within a year or so we should start to see a benefit in the real sector," the spokesman said.
Citibank divested from Nigeria in the 1970s when rules were imposed insisting that government have a stake in all banks and limited foreign investment in any company to 40 percent.
